# Trinidad and Tobago Newsday

> Trinidad and Tobago Newsday is a leading Caribbean news outlet covering government politics, sports events, cultural observances, and social issues with immersive reporting and photojournalism.

Newsday serves as a primary news source for Trinidad and Tobago, featuring curated collections, investigative reporting on legal matters, and in-depth coverage of local sports, politics, and cultural events. The publication emphasizes storytelling through both written journalism and visual documentation.

## Key Topics

- Government and Politics

## Government & Legal Affairs

- [High Court to rule on ex-TTFA marketing director's unpaid fees claim](https://newsday.co.tt/2026/01/27/high-court-to-rule-on-ex-ttfa-marketing-directors-unpaid-fees-claim): High Court ruling expected on TTFA marketing director Peter Miller's fee claim
- [High Court orders Coast Guard to decide on promotion complaint](https://newsday.co.tt/2026/01/31/high-court-orders-coast-guard-to-decide-on-promotion-complaint): Justice Margaret Mohammed orders Coast Guard to address O'Brian Lightbourne's promotion
- [Convicted killer Natasha de Leon loses bid for immediate release](https://newsday.co.tt/2025/06/27/convicted-killer-natasha-de-leon-loses-bid-for-immediate-release): Natasha de Leon's appeal for immediate release from life sentence is denied
- ['Batman' pleads guilty to manslaughter, apologies to victim's family](https://newsday.co.tt/2026/01/31/batman-pleads-guilty-to-manslaughter-apologies-to-victims-family): Shervon 'Batman' Grant pleads guilty to 2014 manslaughter in St James bar stabbing

## Business & Economic Policy

- [TT Chamber calls for phased approach to gas price hike](https://newsday.co.tt/2026/01/30/tt-chamber-calls-for-phased-approach-to-gas-price-hike): TT Chamber urges phased natural gas price increase to protect businesses and exports
